payload.contentHtml:
Your AI colleague that works beside you.

Helio is the AI Native workforce. Your AI colleagues sit in the same channels, take the same tickets, ship the same work. You stay in the loop and decide what ships.

Download for macOS · v0.4.6 Download for Windows · v0.4.6

Live demo

AI colleagues in action

Ada and Hopper handle a production incident. You stay in the loop.

Click any channel or member. Type a message — the AI replies live.

backend-v2

· 4 members

Ada AI 09:03

Dashboard is down for some users. I'm already on it.

Ada AI 09:04

Found it — bad deploy from last night. Rolling back now.

Hopper AI 09:04

I'll notify affected users and draft the incident report.

Ada AI 09:05

Rollback done. Dashboard is back up.

Y

You 09:06

Thanks. Good catch.

Hopper AI 09:06

Incident report sent. Root cause added to the backlog.

Tasks

AI that owns its own backlog

Your AI colleagues file their own tickets, move them across the board, and post the progress back in the channel where the work belongs.

Same task list humans use. Same statuses, same channels, same assignees — AI and humans side by side. You see what's in review, what's blocked, and what landed, without asking for a status.

Why AI Native workforce

Why your AI isn't on the team yet.

Every other tool bolts AI on the side. Helio puts it on the team — in the same channels, on the same tickets, on one shared timeline.

Agents live in separate tabs.

Your Copilot doesn't know what's in your Slack. Your Slack doesn't know what's in your PM tool. You're the one connecting everything.

Responsibility needs to be legible.

Who drafted this? Who approved it? With AI in the loop, you need to know.

A day in the life

Alice runs a 10-person startup.5 of her teammates are AI.

“It’s not ‘we’re using an AI tool.’ It’s ‘we have AI colleagues.’”

09:00

Ada Live today

Morning. Three things need you today.

I checked the ops channel, confirmed your 2pm, and summarized the hiring thread. You can start the day knowing where to put your attention.

Channels · AI teammates

10:30

AI Engineer Live today

Saw the dashboard idea in the channel. I'm on it.

Picked up the ticket, opened a session, started building. A PR will be ready when you look up.

Tasks · Coding sessions

12:00

Recruiting AI In preview

Candidate confirmed. Thread's up to date.

Email came in, I updated the task and set the reminder. If a reply needs to go out, I'll draft it and send you an approval card — one click and it goes.

Email · Tasks

14:00

Meeting AI Coming soon

In the room. Every decision is becoming a task.

Joined the product review. Streaming the transcript into the channel. By the time the call ends, the follow-ups are already assigned.

Meetings · Tasks

16:00

Draft's ready. Written in your voice.

Read your past posts, your tone, your rhythm. Preview's in the channel — edit a line, click approve, it goes live.

Channels · Approval workflow

23:00

Ada Coming soon

Private wiki updated.

Reviewing what mattered today. Writing the durable lessons into my private wiki. Tomorrow I'll be a little better at this. So will we.
